records.text: A police radio dispatcher relayed another report of gunshots near the UVU library and said personnel were trying to lock the library down.
records.speaker: Unidentified Police Radio Dispatcher

appearances.snippet: Just advising there is another report, gunshots heard near the library at UVU. They're trying to lock the library down now, still gathering.

verification.notes: The published episode includes police-radio audio in which a dispatcher relays another report of gunshots near the UVU library and says personnel were trying to lock the library down. Confidence is medium because no separate official dispatch archive was located.

records.text: A police radio dispatcher described a shooter on a far-north building just east of the UVU library, wearing jeans, a black shirt, a black mask, and carrying a long rifle.

appearances.snippet: Focused in because the shooter is on top of the building on the far north side, maybe the CS building. ... Just east of the library, he's wearing jeans, black shirt, black mask, long rifle.
